articles.summary: CEO Bill Grieco directs Innventure’s focus on increasing the value of Accelsius. Parent-level cash expenses expected to significantly decline. Eric Stober to join as new CFO. Michael Madon appointed as new independent director to replace Michael Otworth.
articles.title: Innventure Leadership Increases Focus on Accelsius Value Creation, Implements Significant Cost Cuts, and Strengthens Board Independence
